Class RailwayLineRepository

java.lang.Object
repository.RailwayLineRepository
public class RailwayLineRepository extends Object
Repository class for managing and storing instances of RailwayLine. Provides functionality to save new RailwayLine instances, retrieve all stored railway lines, check for connections between stations, and count railway lines based on specific criteria.
